result:
Round 376's task is written and ready for A. The decision is **CONTINUE**: round 375 passed, but most of the scoped work is still open and nothing external blocks it.

**Round 375 (Library and its preview leaves): done.** C's evidence shows a PASS with 16 rows passed, browser and real checks both true, and 0 bugs. Gate 375 published `6b11be7` to both remotes, and that is the baseline for round 376. GATE374-L2 is closed. I archived the old task as `tasks/round-375.md`; it is byte-identical to what was dispatched.

**Round 376 = PERF-11c-iii-c1 (Transport).** I split PERF-11c-iii-c into c1 (Transport, this round) and c2 (LoopBrace and MarkerRow, next). The scope is unchanged; MarkerRow is a 946-line component with its own editor and focus handling, so it gets its own round.
- **The problem, measured in the browser at HEAD:** every change to the project (adding a clip, zoom, mute, undo, preview start/stop) re-draws the whole Transport bar.
- **The change:** the Transport becomes three independent groups (Edit, Centre, View). Each group re-draws only when its own input changes. Nothing visible changes.
- **Measured on my pre-built version, production build:**
  - zoom.1 goes from 53 to 41 re-rendered components and zoom.30 from 140 to 128; a click goes from 38 to 29.
  - Every drag that commits re-renders 2 to 8 fewer components when released.
  - Starting a range drag costs 2 more components, once. I accepted that because the alternative design costs more.
- **Checks on that version:**
  - All unit tests passed (252 files).
  - Perf had 0 failures.
  - All 10 deliberately broken versions made the tests fail, which shows the new tests catch real regressions.
  - Browser measurements were taken at 1440×900 and 1280×720.
- **tech-lead review:** it found one Medium issue: a keyboard-focus handoff could stay armed after its click. I fixed it in the sketch and added test FL11, which passes on HEAD, fails on the first version and passes on the fixed one. tech-lead then approved; the only remaining findings are Lows, which I recorded in the backlog.
- **Two corrections found while probing:**
  - The browser probe from earlier rounds could not see MarkerRow at all, so it always showed 0 re-draws. The fixed probe shows MarkerRow re-draws on every change, which corrects the starting point for c2.
  - The zoom slider alone does not create zoom history, so C's Zoom-back focus check now starts with Fit.

**Bookkeeping:**
- `backlog.json` is at v341 (decisions D-29z1246 to D-29z1249). It records A's three test Lows: two are fixed in round 376 and one is info.
- Gate 375's review findings are recorded. Its architecture note is the third echo of the open leaf-plumbing checkpoint request, so I restated a bounded request to root. It does not block c1 or c2.
- `feature-status.md` is updated.
- No Critical or High issue is open. The open Mediums are waiting on manual checks, root, or Saba, and none blocks.

**Next:** the 3-day regression round is due at the first planning on or after 2026-11-08, so round 377 will very likely be the regression round. PERF-11c-iii-c2 follows it.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, before planning and at the end. A's code changes are a patch I prepared and tested on a separate copy; I did not edit the app.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-375.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
- b-round-375/ (sketch patch, perf, mutant, probe and review evidence)
